text:
maria: Heads-up: I'm sketching a long-term platform roadmap item for routing policies + multi-region tenant isolation. Goal is a concise PRD covering launch criteria, a minimal policy DSL, canary/runbook steps, and prioritization for customer asks. Thoughts?

aj: We should anchor on three customer archetypes: (1) fast PLG traffic, (2) enterprise with region residency, (3) regulated on-prem. Tradeoffs become concrete.

sunil: Agree. Architecturally we need a clear precedence model: tenant policy > region affinity > capacity fallback. Propose we define two isolation states: "soft quarantine" (throttle + extra telemetry) and "hard eviction" (route out immediately).

taylor: Ops needs explicit runbooks for surge, cross-region failover, and manual tenant eviction. Telemetry triggers we can use: 95th latency spikes, sustained error-rate, and % retriable errors. We'll add thresholds in the SLO doc.

olivia: Sales will ask about SLA, isolation pricing, and how KV caches behave during failover. Need templated answers for contracts and pricing appendix.

maria: Draft launch criteria: 1) v1 policy DSL implemented & unit-tested, 2) canary with 2 tenants across regions for 48h, 3) automated fallback to compatible model variant, 4) runbook + SLO dashboards available in Console, 5) isolation pricing appendix. Good?
aj: Prioritization rubric suggestion: customer impact 40%, risk reduction 30%, implementation effort 30%. With that, policy DSL, telemetry triggers, and fallback logic rank top.
sunil: Minimal DSL example for the PRD so people align: 
```policy
rule: {
  match: { region: "eu", tenant_id: "T-42" },
  action: { isolate: true, fallback_region: "us-west", cache_policy: "preserve_prefix" }
}
```
Also call out compatibility rules for fallbacks (model arch, tokenizer/quantization tolerances).
taylor: Ops playbook fragment: detect -> notify -> shift traffic to fallback lane -> flush or preserve KV cache per policy -> monitor -> escalate if needed. Console should offer one-click rollback and transparent audit logs.
olivia: Add an FAQ: "How quickly can we cut over?" "Is customer data ever sent outside requested jurisdiction?" "What does isolation cost?" Include sample contract text.
maria: Plan: I'll assemble a PRD draft with sections: overview, policy DSL, telemetry & SLOs, runbooks, canary plan, launch criteria, pricing appendix. @aj estimate effort, @sunil write compatibility matrix, @taylor draft runbook skeleton. Target PRD draft by EOD next Tuesday.
deploy-bot: Reminder: PRD draft due 2024-05-07 09:00 UTC.
aj: I'll post estimates tomorrow.
sunil: Will add the compatibility matrix.
taylor: Uploading runbook strawman later today.
maria: Thanks all, will ping review window (48h) when PRD is up.
